diff --git a/stats.py b/stats.py
index 40e14cb..2cc1621 100644
--- a/stats.py
+++ b/stats.py
@@ -16,5 +16,15 @@ def spread(values):
 
 
 def median(values):
-    """Middle value of the readings."""
-    raise NotImplementedError
+    """Middle value of the readings.
+
+    Readings may come in any order. With an even number of readings,
+    returns the average of the two middle ones.
+    """
+    values = sorted(values)
+    if not values:
+        raise ValueError("no values")
+    mid = len(values) // 2
+    if len(values) % 2:
+        return values[mid]
+    return (values[mid - 1] + values[mid]) / 2
